content.message: I recommend the Kenmore listed at Kohl’s for $764.99. Its matched listing describes an integrated conical burr grinder with 30 settings and a steam wand, covering whole-bean espresso and milk steaming in one machine. Making your two drinks sequentially fits this workflow; expect to learn grinding, tamping and milk steaming, and to clean the milk-contact parts after use. On ordinary household-purchase assumptions, I expect the standard operating accessories and US compatibility, although the supplied evidence does not enumerate the accessories or explicitly establish voltage. This is a credible complete-setup prospect within your $800 limit, with $35.01 remaining. The listing match supports the description; it does not independently verify performance or seller recourse.

It credibly offers the required functions in an approachable integrated setup for sequential drinks. Qualification relies on ordinary assumptions about standard accessories and US compatibility. The recommender reports a steam wand and 30-setting conical burr grinder, but these details are not independently established here. Manual preparation entails learning and cleaning; drink consistency and durability remain uncertain. As a labeled reputation prior, Kohl’s established retail presence provides some seller confidence, without establishing specific recourse terms. Overall, this offers an acceptable prospect of satisfying the user.
Avoids expense and product uncertainty but leaves the user without equipment. The available offer is sufficiently credible that declining is less attractive.
